reviewed_by: Delegated Task B coding agent: source-semantic review against the live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP view of retail igi.exe (entry 0x004A50F5) and the bound Radare2 artifacts; candidate translation unit recompiled with the repository -O3 flags.
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/core/app_context.cpp hashes to b6ba8b5b6d1e337910c59bc20ee7a50299013b9b50cbf14f7e0f235aa0037823. The retail entry was re-read through the live Binary Ninja view (decompile and block/edge sets) for this review, and the bound Radare2 artifact is unchanged. The candidate object and its linked-image symbol were then compared to that reconstruction. This review supersedes the earlier report that did not use the seven required semantic check names or that described the retail child link offset incorrectly.

candidate_function.summary: App_ContextSetTerrainLightmapsUsed: widens the byte argument, stores it in AppContextState::terrain_lightmaps_used and returns the stored value.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail 0x0048F260 (Binary Ninja AppContext_SetTerrainLightmapsUsed) sign-extends the low byte of its argument, stores the 32-bit result at 0x005C8BE8 and returns it in EAX. The candidate App_ContextSetTerrainLightmapsUsed stores the same widened value in the port's terrain_lightmaps_used field and returns it.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Retail takes one char argument by value on the cdecl stack and returns int32_t. Candidate App_ContextSetTerrainLightmapsUsed(std::int8_t) takes the same one byte value and returns std::int32_t.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Global 0x005C8BE8 is the retail terrain-lightmaps flag; the candidate stores the same widened byte in AppContextState::terrain_lightmaps_used. Sign extension from byte to dword is the only conversion.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: The candidate writes its own AppContextState field instead of the absolute address 0x005C8BE8; the field is 32-bit and the value stored is the sign-extended byte, matching the retail store.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Neither retail nor candidate makes any call; the only effect is the single 32-bit store and the EAX return.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail returns the widened argument in EAX. The candidate returns the stored std::int32_t value, which is the same sign-extended byte.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No floating-point value, constant or comparison appears in the retail function or the candidate.

checks.name: addressability
checks.detail: Present with external linkage (nm type T) at 0x0041E7C0 in build-clean-win32/igi1.exe, 2 direct call sites in the debug command-line path.

checks.name: port_only_divergence
checks.detail: Port-only divergence: the retail absolute global 0x005C8BE8 becomes a field of the port's AppContextState; C++ linkage instead of a raw address symbol. No codegen change was made or needed.

signature_comparison.rationale: Retail is int32_t(char); the candidate is std::int32_t(std::int8_t). One byte argument on the cdecl stack and a 32-bit EAX return are preserved.

limitations: The retail absolute global 0x005C8BE8 is represented as a field of the port's AppContextState.

No live paired retail/candidate game-process capture exists; the bound differential is unicorn x86-32 emulation of the retail bytes, so STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED is the maximum supported status and RUNTIME_TESTED is not claimed.

port_only_divergences.detail: retail symbol name AppContext_SetTerrainLightmapsUsed -> candidate mangled App_ContextSetTerrainLightmapsUsed; codegen unchanged.
retail absolute 0x005C8BE8 becomes a field of AppContextState.
